title.why: Cover title 고영향 인공지능 사업자 책무 가이드라인 = 'Guideline on the (duties/responsibilities of) high-impact AI business operators'; 책무 is rendered 'responsibilities', a fair literal rendering. The Article 34 parenthesis is the guideline's own scope (page 3) and not part of the cover title; acceptable as a rendered English title.

original_title.why: Matches the cover text layer 고영향 인공지능 사업자 책무 가이드라인 character by character (line break after 사업자 only).

issuing_body.why: Page 3 says 과학기술정보통신부는 ... 본 가이드라인을 마련하였고 ('the Ministry of Science and ICT prepared this guideline'). NIA distribution is shown by the NIA post. TTA appears on the cover only as an image; not required.

date_published.why: NIA post dated 2026.01.22 with file 260122_..._책무_가이드라인; a posting date, consistent with the file-name date.

status.why: NIA notice says the posted guidelines are the current versions (현재본).

legal_force.why: Guideline says it supports operators' understanding and performance of legal obligations; it is guidance, not itself a legal rule.

english_version.why: kind 'none found'; no English version is stored for this record, nothing contradicts it.

safety_topics.why: human oversight (3.4), accountability, transparency (explanation plan), evaluation/testing (ISO/IEC TS 42119-2 reference), risk classification (high-impact) all appear in the text.

summary_claims.claim: Article 34 duties: risk-management plan; plan to explain final results, main criteria and overview of training data 'as far as technically feasible'; user-protection plan; human management and supervision; documents showing safety and reliability measures; other matters resolved by the committee
summary_claims.locator: page 3, list items 1-6 (line 38-46 of text); Article 34 text at page ~14
summary_claims.translation: '2. Establishing and implementing a plan to explain, to the extent technically feasible, the final result produced by the AI, the main criteria used to derive that result, and an overview of the training data used in developing and using the AI ... 5. Drafting and keeping documents that make the content of the measures to secure safety and reliability verifiable; 6. Other matters deliberated and resolved by the Committee for securing the safety and reliability of high-impact AI.' The summary's rendering matches; 위원회에서 심의·의결된 사항 = 'matters deliberated and resolved by the committee', summarised as 'resolved by the committee' (slightly shortened, not misleading).

summary_claims.claim: It reproduces the decree and notification provisions and appends a document form, a self-check list and a hiring example
summary_claims.locator: Table of contents page 2 (안전신뢰문서 양식, 자가점검 항목, 채용분야 작성 예시); 관련 시행령 section 2.2; '관련 기술고시 조문' boxes

summary_claims.claim: Decree Art. 27 (notes): operators post main elements of plans and the supervising person's name and contact on premises or website, trade secrets excepted; a using operator taking over from a developer who took measures 1 to 3 without significant change is deemed to have taken them
summary_claims.translation: '... shall post the following on the AI business operator's office, place of business or website, provided that matters that are trade secrets under the Unfair Competition Prevention Act may be excluded ... 4. the name and contact of the person who manages and supervises the high-impact AI' and '(3) where an AI-using operator that was provided an AI system by an operator that took all or some of the measures of Art. 34(1) 1-3 has not made a significant functional change, such as markedly changing the original purpose or use, it is deemed to have taken all or some of the measures of items 1 to 3.'

summary_claims.claim: Notification Articles 4 to 8 correspond to the five duties; refers to ISO/IEC TS 42119-2:2025 on AI system testing
summary_claims.locator: '관련 기술고시 조문' boxes (제4조 위험관리방안, 제5조 설명방안 ...); text line ~1670 on ISO/IEC TS 42119-2:2025

scope.note: Government guideline implementing the AI Basic Act's high-impact AI duties.

note: All changed text (summary, notes, verification note) matches the Korean original. The five-plus-one Article 34 duties, the 'to the extent technically feasible' qualifier on the explanation plan, decree Article 27 posting and deemed-compliance rules, and the annexes were each found in the stored PDF text and translated literally. The evidence script reported no errors. The notification's number and status are honestly left open. The record states no English version, which fits the stored sources. No newer version was found in the stored material.
